التقاط التوقيع

The electronic or manual recording of a recipient's signature at the point of delivery as proof of receipt in transport documentation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is التقاط التوقيع?

In this glossary, التقاط التوقيع refers to: The electronic or manual recording of a recipient's signature at the point of delivery as proof of receipt in transport documentation.

How is التقاط التوقيع used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "يلزم التقاط التوقيع لجميع مستندات إثبات التسليم (POD) في عمليات النقل البري عبر الحدود."

Why does التقاط التوقيع matter in logistics?

التقاط التوقيع matters because it supports clear communication in Visibility and Tracking contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses التقاط التوقيع?

التقاط التوقيع is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does التقاط التوقيع belong to?

In this glossary, التقاط التوقيع is grouped under Visibility and Tracking. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The electronic or manual recording of a recipient's signature at the point of delivery as proof of receipt in transport documentation.

Operational example

Signature capture is required for all Proof of Delivery (POD) documentation in cross-border road transport operations.

Localized term
